value.answer: Ear tugging with night crying in a toddler, especially after a cold, is often an ear infection. Pain tends to feel worse lying down. Comfort measures and pain relief usually help; many mild ear infections improve on their own in a day or two.
value.triage: Call 811 if pain lasts more than 1-2 days, there's fever, or you're unsure what to do. Go to the ER or call 911 now if there's fluid, pus or blood draining from the ear, swelling/redness behind or around the ear, a stiff neck, severe pain, or your child seems very unwell or hard to wake.
